entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A knock came on the door. Prime Min..."
entries.dialogueText: A knock came on the door. Prime Minister Saltana and Supreme Wiseman Azmal had arrived.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A lot had happened since I promised..."
entries.dialogueText: A lot had happened since I promised the Derdian and Morellan leaders that I would mediate between them. But I was still determined to find a solution.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They and a handful of their ministe..."
entries.dialogueText: They and a handful of their ministers joined myself and Laurento around the conference table.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So. Here we all are.""
entries.dialogueText: "So. Here we all are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd like to begin with a short pra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to begin with a short prayer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Supreme Wiseman's eyes shone wi..."
entries.dialogueText: The Supreme Wiseman's eyes shone with delight. His Morellan counterpart crossed her arms impatiently.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If you must.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you must."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies, gentleman. Shall we get ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies, gentleman. Shall we get right to it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you both for joining me. I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you both for joining me. I am confident we can accomplish great things today."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Gladly, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we gather today, I pray that we..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we gather today, I pray that we do not let our trivial differences blind us. For we are but one people, united by God's enduring love."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""O Divine Creator, bless this media..."
entries.dialogueText: "O Divine Creator, bless this mediation table and all who are seated at it. Help them to open their hearts and minds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lord, guide me in my sacred duty o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lord, guide me in my sacred duty of finding communion between the nations of the former Empire of Moridia, that we may come together against the greater powers who wish us harm."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Halaita, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal and Saltana looked at each ot..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal and Saltana looked at each other uneasily.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Yes. Here we are.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Here we are."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento tented his fingers on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento tented his fingers on the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened a folder and pulled out a..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened a folder and pulled out a map of Derdia, Rizia and Morella with a diagram drawn on it.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We call this St. Wruhec's Corridor.""
entries.dialogueText: "We call this St. Wruhec's Corridor."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Each year, a select number of Derd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each year, a select number of Derdians with an appropriate prayer visa will be allowed into Morella via this specific channel. It includes the most important sanctuaries on the Golcondist pilgrimage route."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia re-allowed Derdian Golcondis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia re-allowed Derdian Golcondists into our places of worship with no ill consequences."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Rizia shares no borders with Derdi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia shares no borders with Derdia. The only reason you have not been overwhelmed by an influx of so-called pilgrims is because we have been holding them back."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The route continues into Rizia, wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "The route continues into Rizia, where Derdian pilgrims have been permitted for some time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Supreme Wiseman leaned forward..."
entries.dialogueText: The Supreme Wiseman leaned forward and scrutinized the map.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""This route ends at Lauante. After..."
entries.dialogueText: "This route ends at Lauante. After which, I suppose, we are to march into the sea?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You go home the way you came. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "You go home the way you came. It's not that difficult."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may continue into Rizia, as lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may continue into Rizia, as long as you agree to respect our blasphemy law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not a bad idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not a bad idea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not at all. I fully plan on allowi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all. I fully plan on allowing Golcondists to worship in Rizia as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Azmal and Saltana glowered at..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Azmal and Saltana glowered at me. The Morellan prime minister cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""{RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "{RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}, you cannot really expect Morella to allow in Golcondist pilgrims while barring them from your own sanctuaries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our Wruhecist community is larger..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Wruhecist community is larger than Morella's. There is greater potential for disruption."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm afraid revoking our blasphemy..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid revoking our blasphemy law is out of the question. The Wruhecist Sanctuary is very powerful in this country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is in the middle of a war. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is in the middle of a war. I don't want to make any sudden policy changes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal raised his eyebrows skeptical..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal raised his eyebrows skeptically.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You plan on it. I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "You plan on it. I see."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You will forgive me if I don't pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will forgive me if I don't place much stock in your promises."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana looked at us both uneasily."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana looked at us both uneasily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We all know why we are here.""
entries.dialogueText: "We all know why we are here."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your countries have been engaged i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your countries have been engaged in border disputes for years. Rizia has promised to help you find a common solution."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rizia has formed energy partnershi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has formed energy partnerships with both of your countries. It would behoove us all to find a solution to your border disputes."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""With all due respect, Mr. Esquibel..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. Esquibel..."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Rizia has proven itself an unrelia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has proven itself an unreliable energy partner. Why should we trust you as a mediator?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana smiled coolly."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana smiled coolly.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Funny, Mr. Azmal. Rizia has failed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny, Mr. Azmal. Rizia has failed to meet its energy promises to us as well."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It seems we have one thing in comm..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems we have one thing in common after all."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Rizia has proven itself an unrelia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has proven itself an unreliable energy partner. Why should we trust you as a mediator?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan prime minister nodded."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan prime minister nodded.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A pipeline runs between Derdia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pipeline runs between Derdia and Morella now. If these insurgencies continue, our economies and image will suffer."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It is time we put an end to these..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time we put an end to these insurgencies. Our international image has suffered enough."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""With all due respect, Mr. Esquibel..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. Esquibel..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now is not the time to talk about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now is not the time to talk about the energy situation. You may bring it up with me later."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am truly sorry that our conflict..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly sorry that our conflict with Pales interfered with our promised energy deliveries. Once we have won, I will repay you triplefold."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our energy deliveries were impeded..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our energy deliveries were impeded by circumstances beyond my control. I sincerely apologize for that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have more than that in common...."
entries.dialogueText: "You have more than that in common. It was only a few generations ago that the Moridians were one people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal nodded vigorously."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded vigorously.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Precisely, Your Majesty. Which is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely, Your Majesty. Which is why it is so ludicrous that Derdians are being denied entrance into Morella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't have a choice, do you? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have a choice, do you? It's Rizia or nobody."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana pursed her lips."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana pursed her lips.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal gritted his teeth."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal gritted his teeth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked over at Azmal. He reluct..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked over at Azmal. He reluctantly nodded.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Very well. Let's continue.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Let's continue."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Very well. Let's continue.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Let's continue."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Insurgencies! It's exactly that ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Insurgencies! It's exactly that kind of language that has made me reluctant to deal with you, Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Are you sure it's my language you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure it's my language you have a problem with, Mr. Azmal? Not the fact that I'm a woman who holds more power than you?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We would gladly welcome you if you..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would gladly welcome you if you behaved yourselves. Instead, we get raids, insurgencies..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Even if it's not currently in use,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if it's not currently in use, a pipeline runs between Derdia and Morella now. If these insurgencies continue, our economies and image will suffer."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""With or without a Rizian energy de..."
entries.dialogueText: "With or without a Rizian energy deal, it is time we put an end to these insurgencies. Our international image has suffered enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will address the Supreme Wisem..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will address the Supreme Wiseman using his full title, Prime Minister Saltana."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face darkened."
entries.dialogueText: Her face darkened.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty. But I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. But I am adamantly opposed to the intrusion of religion into statecraft."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""And yet you cannot deny those who..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yet you cannot deny those who do believe in a higher power the right to worship as their ancestors have."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Both of you are, it seems.""
entries.dialogueText: "Both of you are, it seems."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's obviously only one way to..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's obviously only one way to solve this. A Duel of Generosity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento turned pale. Saltana burst..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento turned pale. Saltana burst out laughing.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A king who just married his daught..."
entries.dialogueText: "A king who just married his daughter to his cousin is proposing a duel."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A king who just married off his da..."
entries.dialogueText: "A king who just married off his daughter to expand his territory is proposing a duel."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A duel. Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "A duel. Really?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'm here to talk politics, gentlem..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm here to talk politics, gentleman. Not play some sort of... game of thrones."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""A duel won't be necessary, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "A duel won't be necessary, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""This is a problem with an easy sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a problem with an easy solution. Allow Derdian Golcondists the freedom to practice their religion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never mind the Prime Minister's la..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind the Prime Minister's language, Supreme Wiseman. You must admit that the violent conduct of your people at the Morellan border has not been justified."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face darkened."
entries.dialogueText: His face darkened.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I will admit no such thing.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will admit no such thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop squabbling at once, both of y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop squabbling at once, both of you. Your conduct is befitting of kindergarteners, not world leaders."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Saltana and Azmal looked down..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Saltana and Azmal looked down at the table.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty. However...."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. However..."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You may both run godless countries..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may both run godless countries yourselves."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You may not believe in God yoursel..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not believe in God yourself, Ms. Saltana."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is it the right to worship you are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is it the right to worship you are after, or is it Morella's resources? We have not forgotten the Meftiem invasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The borders between Derdia and Mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "The borders between Derdia and Morella were drawn only recently. They do feel rather arbitrary."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""And yet they are there for a reaso..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yet they are there for a reason."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What Derdians do hardly falls unde..."
entries.dialogueText: "What Derdians do hardly falls under the category of worship."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That was the work of rogue actors...."
entries.dialogueText: "That was the work of rogue actors. And furthermore, it occurred long before my appointment as Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You are still under the sway of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are still under the sway of your Grand Wiseman, I see. Even after having arrested him."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You are still under the sway of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are still under the sway of your Grand Wiseman, I see."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Supreme Wiseman, Madam Prime Minis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Supreme Wiseman, Madam Prime Minister. This is the solution my department has devised for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His finger traced a thick black lin..."
entries.dialogueText: His finger traced a thick black line from the Derdian-Morellan border towards the Antacean coast.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If you don't mind, I would like to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't mind, I would like to have more than a mere assurance from you before agreeing to anything."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Then I cannot agree to your plan.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then I cannot agree to your plan."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Nor can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor can I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're in a delicate situation with..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're in a delicate situation with Wehlen at the moment. I don't want to make any sudden policy changes."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If you believe disruption is a con..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you believe disruption is a concern at all, then I cannot agree to this plan."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Nor can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor can I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So be it. I tried my best.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it. I tried my best."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. I don't have a Grand Wiseman..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. I don't have a Grand Wiseman to appease anymore. I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately."
entries.menuText: "Wait. I don't have a Grand Wiseman to appease anymore. I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. If it helps your nations get..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. If it helps your nations get along, I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately."
entries.menuText: "Wait. If it helps your nations get along, I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's nothing I can do. That was..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing I can do. That was my kingdom's best effort."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have a Grand Wiseman to ap..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have a Grand Wiseman to appease anymore. I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately."
entries.menuText: "I don't have a Grand Wiseman to appease anymore. I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. If it helps your nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. If it helps your nations get along, I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately."
entries.menuText: "Very well. If it helps your nations get along, I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry. An assurance is all I can g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. An assurance is all I can give you right now."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Then I cannot agree to this propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I cannot agree to this proposal."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Nor can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor can I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like your attitude, Suprem..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like your attitude, Supreme Wiseman. I will promise you nothing."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""How fortunate, Your Majesty. I kne..."
entries.dialogueText: "How fortunate, Your Majesty. I knew you would see the light someday."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am not certain I believe you, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not certain I believe you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Thank you anyway for your hard wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you anyway for your hard work, Mr. Esquibel. This corridor would have been an ideal compromise."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thank you, Madam Prime Minister. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Madam Prime Minister. It may still be an option in the future, even if it is not possible today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana eyed me suspiciously."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana eyed me suspiciously.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""How do we know the Derdians will s..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do we know the Derdians will stick to the route as they pass through Morella?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will send a company from the Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will send a company from the Rizian Armed Forces to grant the pilgrims secure passage."
entries.menuText: "I will send a company from the Rizian Armed Forces to grant the pilgrims secure passage." [Manpower -250]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia will pay for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia will pay for a small team of independent contractors to oversee the corridor's security."
entries.menuText: "The Kingdom of Rizia will pay for a small team of independent contractors to oversee the corridor's security." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whoever violates the agreement wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whoever violates the agreement will face the most severe of consequences. My kingdom will make sure of it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I can accept that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can accept that."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""So can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "So can I."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I cannot.""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""How do *we* know the Morellans wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do *we* know the Morellans will not attempt to block it?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I'm afraid that's not enough assur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid that's not enough assurance for me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I think it's a fine plan. But it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's a fine plan. But it's not entirely up to me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Nor for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor for me."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I can accept that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can accept that."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""So can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "So can I."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I'm afraid that's not enough assur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid that's not enough assurance for me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I cannot.""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I think it's a fine plan. But it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's a fine plan. But it's not entirely up to me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Nor for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor for me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thank you both for your swift will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you both for your swift willingness to compromise."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Such solutions always seem easy wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such solutions always seem easy when it's a third party proposing them, don't they?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I can accept that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can accept that."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""So can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "So can I."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I'm afraid that's not enough assur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid that's not enough assurance for me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I cannot.""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I think it's a fine plan. But it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it's a fine plan. But it's not entirely up to me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Nor for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor for me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then you're both out of luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you're both out of luck."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We'll assemble a team from all thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll assemble a team from all three of our countries to begin the creation of the corridor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. We will send *two* army comp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. We will send *two* army companies."
entries.menuText: "Fine. We will send *two* army companies." [-500 Manpower]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. We will pour twice as much f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. We will pour twice as much funding into security as planned."
entries.menuText: "Fine. We will pour twice as much funding into security as planned." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. A company from the Rizian Ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. A company from the Rizian Armed Forces will be physically present to grant the pilgrims secure passage."
entries.menuText: "Fine. A company from the Rizian Armed Forces will be physically present to grant the pilgrims secure passage." [Manpower -250]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you insist, the Kingdom of Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you insist, the Kingdom of Rizia will pay for a small team of independent contractors to oversee the corridor's security."
entries.menuText: "If you insist, the Kingdom of Rizia will pay for a small team of independent contractors to oversee the corridor's security." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two of them looked at each othe..."
entries.dialogueText: The two of them looked at each other. Each gave a short, approving nod.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In addition to the military reinfo..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition to the military reinforcements, we will contract a team of independent security officers."
entries.menuText: "In addition to the military reinforcements, we will contract a team of independent security officers." [-250 Manpower, -1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In addition to the security firm,..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition to the security firm, we ourselves will send a company from the Rizian Armed Forces."
entries.menuText: "In addition to the security firm, we ourselves will send a company from the Rizian Armed Forces." [-1 Budget, -250 Manpower]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're just going to have to trust..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're just going to have to trust each other, aren't you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two of them looked at each othe..."
entries.dialogueText: The two of them looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I should have known this would not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have known this would not be a serious plan."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana's brow was furrowed."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana's brow was furrowed.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Even if the corridor ends at Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if the corridor ends at Rizia's holy sites..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You really thought we could erase..."
entries.dialogueText: "You really thought we could erase a century's worth of resentment in five minutes?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That's it, then? You agree?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's it, then? You agree?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Morella and Derdia can come to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Morella and Derdia can come to a diplomatic agreement this quickly, I have high hopes for the Intermerkopum alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Saltana, I hope thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana, I hope this means that I can count on your cooperation during the final MITZ vote."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord has truly blessed us on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord has truly blessed us on this day. Rejoice!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your hard work, Laur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your hard work, Laurento. This was truly a team effort."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You honor me, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You honor me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled mysteriously."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled mysteriously.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We will see, {RiziaDLCText.Saltana..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will see, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Halaita!""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita!"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""...Yes. Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "...Yes. Halaita."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Agreed, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento checked his pocketwatch."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento checked his pocketwatch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two of them looked away from ea..."
entries.dialogueText: The two of them looked away from each other. Laurento attempted to mask his disappointment.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's fine. We don't need Morella a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. We don't need Morella and Derdia to get along for the Intermerkopum alliance to work out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alas, the Lord has not blessed us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alas, the Lord has not blessed us on this day. Perhaps we did something to anger Him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Saltana, I hope I c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana, I hope I can still count on your cooperation during the final MITZ vote."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, thanks anyway, Laurento. This..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thanks anyway, Laurento. This was a great idea."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You honor me, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You honor me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her expression betrayed no emotion."
entries.dialogueText: Her expression betrayed no emotion.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""No comment, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "No comment, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I must say it would have helped, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say it would have helped, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento checked his pocketwatch."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento checked his pocketwatch.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We will see, {RiziaDLCText.Saltana..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will see, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, wait. I do have one idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, wait. I do have one idea."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Yes, {Salutations.SaltanaToPlayer}..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, {Salutations.SaltanaToPlayer} ?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Suddenly the man who believes in a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Suddenly the man who believes in an invisible person in the sky doesn't have faith in his own neighbor?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal gasped indignantly. Saltana l..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal gasped indignantly. Saltana laughed out loud.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must take a leap of faith, Sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must take a leap of faith, Supreme Wiseman. What would St. Wruhec have done?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""As Wruhec himself said, the firmes..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Wruhec himself said, the firmest bridge of trust may still be eroded by the waters of deceit."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana shrugged.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We still have the Derdia-Wehlen me..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have the Derdia-Wehlen mediations scheduled for today. Perhaps a short break?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We are finished here. I am truly s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are finished here. I am truly sorry we were not able to help you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Derdian Supreme Wiseman and Mor..."
entries.dialogueText: The Derdian Supreme Wiseman and Morellan prime minister rose and shook both of our hands.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I will see you in the Trade Zone n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""May God be with you both.""
entries.dialogueText: "May God be with you both."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They and their entourages were esco..."
entries.dialogueText: They and their entourages were escorted out of the suite.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, thank you. I must clear my he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thank you. I must clear my head of prejudice after what just occurred."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan prime minister rose an..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan prime minister rose and shook our hands.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I will see you in the Trade Zone n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and her entourage were escorted..."
entries.dialogueText: She and her entourage were escorted out of the suite.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We still have the Derdia-Wehlen me..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have the Derdia-Wehlen mediations scheduled for today. Perhaps a short break?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'd like to go over a detail or tw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to go over a detail or two about that first. I'll escort you to the door."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and her entourage followed him..."
entries.dialogueText: She and her entourage followed him out of the suite.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, thank you. This was surprisin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thank you. This was surprisingly pleasant, but I do not expect our interaction with President Smolak to go as smoothly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan prime minister rose an..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan prime minister rose and shook our hands.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I will see you in the Trade Zone n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We are finished here. I am happy R..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are finished here. I am happy Rizia was able to help you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan prime minister rose fr..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan prime minister rose from her seat.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I will see you in the Trade Zone n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""With all due respect, Mr. Esquibel..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Mr. Esquibel..."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We in Morella have been paying att..."
entries.dialogueText: "We in Morella have been paying attention to Rizia's internal politics. Your increasingly authoritarian policies leave us wondering about your reliability as a mediator."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't have a choice, do you? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have a choice, do you? It's Rizia or nobody."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has always been an absolute..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has always been an absolute monarchy, Ms. Saltana. You just chose to ignore it when it suited you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hear your concerns, but they're..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear your concerns, but they're not germane to today's conversation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have no idea what you're talki..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have no idea what you're talking about. The people of my country enjoy a great many freedoms. More than Morella, in fact."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gritted her teeth."
entries.dialogueText: She gritted her teeth.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Excuse me? That's just not true.""
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me? That's just not true."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Madam Prime Minister, whatever our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Madam Prime Minister, whatever our internal situation, we remain committed to finding a diplomatic compromise between your country and Derdia. And we are willing to put our money where our mouth is, so to speak."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento laughed nervously."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento laughed nervously.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""No? I'd like to know just what kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "No? I'd like to know just what kind of monarchy I'm dealing with."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Derdia appreciates that commitment..."
entries.dialogueText: "Derdia appreciates that commitment, Mr. Esquibel. As well as your tough but fair treatment of dissenters."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana sighed reluctantly."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana sighed reluctantly.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""All right. Let's proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Let's proceed."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Derdia and Morella are now connect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Derdia and Morella are now connected by an energy pipeline. If Derdians continue to violate our borders, the economies and our images of both nations will suffer."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It is time we put an end to these..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time we put an end to these insurgencies. Our international image has suffered enough."
